{{Quote|Word is that some Imperial captain has hijacked and taken control of a Star Destroyer.|[[Hirael Chindiaye]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:LSD" />}}
The '''retaking of the ''Blackguard''''' was a mission undertaken by a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], to retake the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] known as the [[Blackguard (Star Destroyer)|''Blackguard'']] from the traitorous Imperial [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] and self-proclaimed [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Andal Sait]].

{{Battle-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The retaking of the ''Blackguard'' appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:SD" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The retaking of the ''Blackguard'' was featured in the game as the [[W:c:swg:Lost Star Destroyer|"Star Destroyer" Heroic Encounter]].<ref name="SWG:SD" /> It was introduced to the game in the [[W:c:swg:Chapter 8 Notes for Jan 15 2008|"Chapter 8" update]], released on [[November 1]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 8: The Nova Orion Crisis">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67563&month=012008|text=Chapter 8: The Nova Orion Crisis}}</ref>
